searchText: Hello, @everyone I am a senior full stack blockchain developer with 3+ years experience. I have worked on several blockchain projects such as DeFi, NFT and Cross-Chain Bridge. I am a full time developer in any timezone and will do my best for the projects. Thank you. This Discord is for Ethereum R&D discussion. It isn't for application layer recruitment. As per the Welcome message, try CryptoDevs discord: https://discord.gg/5W5tVb3 From the cryptodevs server, these posts are just bots, sometimes legit accounts that have been compromised, they wait for people to DM them for freelance work and then run off with the money, we usually just ban posts like these on sight now We've seen an uptick in the last month or so
